subject: Calendar match — Dedicated throughput demo for CloudVault
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@cloudvault.ai>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity demo — signed up via self-serve

Hi Rohan,

We just completed the self-serve signup and are evaluating Redwood Dedicated for steady production inference. We're interested in a short technical demo focused on throughput and latency tradeoffs for our agent summarization pipeline.

Key constraints:
- Peak concurrent QPS: ~250 requests/sec (spiky between 150–300)
- Avg seq length: 1k tokens
- Latency SLO target: p95 < 150 ms for generation-only (no heavy rerank)

Can you share available 30–45 minute windows next week? Prefer mornings (PST). If you have an intake form, please send it over — happy to fill with more details.

Thanks,
Jamie Park
Senior ML Engineer
CloudVault Solutions
Attachments: metrics_screenshot.png (png)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@cloudvault.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo — signed up via self-serve

Hi Jamie — great to meet you and thanks for signing up.

We can definitely cover throughput + latency tuning for Dedicated. Quick asks so we tailor the call:
- Is the 250 QPS primarily inference requests (generation) or includes embedding/other workloads?
- Any data residency or VPC requirement we should plan for on the call?

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-10 09:30–10:15
- Wed 2026-11-11 10:00–10:45
- Thu 2026-11-12 08:30–09:15

I've attached a short intake form to capture model sizes, token distributions, and peak scheduling (dedicated_intake_form.xlsx). If none of the windows work, tell me a couple that do and we'll adjust.

I'll loop in Ben (Solutions) for the deep-dive on autoscale/throughput sizing.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachments: dedicated_intake_form.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@cloudvault.ai>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo — signed up via self-serve

Thanks Rohan — answers below.

- 250 QPS is generation requests only (we run token-limited single-shot summary calls — no embeddings in that path).
- No VPC in the initial pilot; we'll evaluate private deployment later.

We can do Wed 2026-11-11 10:00–10:45 PST. I've attached a quick screenshot from our current infra showing request spikes and token distribution.

Also: our procurement lead (procurement@cloudvault.ai) will join for any pricing questions.

Jamie
